title: HowlForge Verification Evidence
description: What the departing worker verified. HowlForge reads this evidence and never reproduces it: HowlProof owns verification execution. Independence is recorded truthfully, so a worker that verified its own output says so and HowlProof decides what that is worth.

status.description: Anything other than an explicit pass counts as not passed, so a malformed or absent status can never read as success.

independent.description: Whether verification was performed by a different worker than the one that produced the change.
